this_accession_holds: U2 (untrained leg after Period 1, n=21), T3/U3 (both legs before Period 2, n=13/12), T4/U4 (both legs after Period 2, n=10/12); T1/T2 (Period 1 trained-leg pre/post) are deposited in GSE58608/GSE60590, not here
assay: bulk RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis, Illumina HiSeq 2000 paired-end; TopHat/Cufflinks FPKM and HTSeq gene counts (S4.5.p1)
design: one-legged endurance training: Period 1 trains one leg (T), other leg untrained (U); after 9-month break Period 2 trains both legs (S2.1.p1, S4.2.p1-p2, FIG1)
repeated_measure_unit: subject (both legs and all time points from the same individual)
primary_estimand: within-subject effect of 3-month one-legged endurance training on skeletal muscle gene expression; in this accession: Period 2 training response in the previously trained leg (T4 vs T3) and in the previously untrained leg (U4 vs U3)
planned_contrasts: T4 vs T3 (Period 2, previously trained leg; S2.4.p2: 852 genes, n=10 individuals FIG2c)
U4 vs U3 (Period 2, previously untrained leg; S2.4.p2: 928 genes, n=11 individuals FIG2d)
T3 vs U3 (memory, before Period 2; S2.4.p1: no specific genes differed)
T4 vs U4 (after Period 2; S2.4.p2: OPLS no statistical difference)
T2 vs T1 and U2 vs T1 (Period 1; need GSE58608/GSE60590, out of this accession)
sample_inclusion: S1 Table marks samples failing RNA-seq QC (not available here); paper per-comparison n: T3vsT4 20 samples, U3vsU4 22 samples (TAB1)
normalization: Cufflinks FPKM, ComBat batch-corrected, genes with mean FPKM > 1 (12,848 genes) (S2.1.p2, S4.5.p1, S4.6.p1)
paper_method: OPLS (Simca p+13) on mean-centred, UV-scaled batch-corrected FPKM; significance = |loading| - |jack-knife CI| > 0 at 99% confidence (S4.6.p1-p2). Limma on HTSeq counts is named in S4.5.p1 and used for novel transcripts (S4.8.p1, adj p <= 0.05, TAB3)
